findings.reasoning: The function is public and has no authorization check, allowing any user to trigger the payout and set payedOut to true, potentially draining funds intended for a specific winner.

The call to winner.send(winAmount) ignores the returned boolean, so a failed transfer (e.g., if the winner is a contract with a fallback that uses more than 2300 gas) will not revert and the contract will incorrectly mark the payout as completed.
The function is public and only checks that payedOut is true; any caller can withdraw the remaining balance after payout, effectively stealing leftover ether.
The call to msg.sender.send(this.balance) ignores the return value, so a failed transfer will not revert and the contract may retain ether unintentionally.
